description: This file implements CSI (Channel State Information) processing and management functions for a WiFi module, including handling CSI data reception, starting/stopping CSI measurements, and maintaining a list of active CSI sessions.

methods.name: INT process_csi(mac_address_t mac_addr,wifi_csi_data_t * csi_data)
methods.description: Processes received CSI data; creates and dispatches a WiFi event containing CSI info.

methods.name: void update_pinger_config(int ap_index,mac_addr_t mac_addr,bool pause_pinger)
methods.description: Updates the configuration for the CSI pinger, enabling or pausing it based on parameters.

methods.name: int csi_start_fn(void * csi_app,unsigned int ap_index,mac_addr_t mac_addr,int sounding_app)
methods.description: Handles starting CSI measurement for a specific MAC address and app, managing resource limitations.

methods.name: int csi_stop_fn(void * csi_app,unsigned int ap_index,mac_addr_t mac_addr,int sounding_app)
methods.description: Handles stopping CSI measurement for a specific MAC address and app, freeing resources.

methods.name: int csi_init(wifi_app_t * app,unsigned int create_flag)
methods.description: Initializes CSI module within the WiFi application, registering callbacks and creating internal data structures.
